446:
Could it wait until tomorrow?
It's New Year, and they did try in their own way.
447:
We're outside the city.
Docent is unlikely to find us.
448:
All right, but don't leave the house!
We forwarded your letter
449:
to Sheremetyev's wife.
Here's her reply, addressed to him.
450:
- You'll have lunch with us on the first? Promise?
- We promise!
451:
What a pity. Such nice woman,
and her father is a fence, a profiteer.
452:
What's all this shouting?
Who gave you permission to go out? - He's back... Radish.
454:
The New Year is here. I hope
it brings each of you a new beginning.
455:
Anything may happen, but remember:
wherever you are, wherever I am,
456:
I'll always remember you.
I'll be sure to find you.
457:
- And now... Just a moment...
- Where's he off to?
458:
Who knows? You can't make sense
of him anymore.
459:
What's to make sense of?
He says he'll find us anywhere and slit our throats.
461:
They say he took a razor to Pockface's throat,
and that was that. - The jackal's gone savage.
462:
Look who's here! Father Frost has come
with gifts for everyone!
463:
- Come here, Fedya. - What did I do?
- Come on. Wear these at home, in good health.
464:
- What do I need them for? I don't have a home.
- You will. There's time.
465:
- Meanwhile, they'll be useful in prison. Wear them.
- Always predicting the worst.
466:
These are for you, Vasya...
And these for you, Gavrila Petrovich. - Thanks.
467:
- Pure wool.
- This is for you, too.
469: Sour stuff. It's dull without vodka.
470:
- Do we have to get drunk as pigs?
- What else is there to do?
471:
We could sit and talk,
heart to heart.
472:
I'm not a prosecutor.
I'm not having a heart-to-heart with you. - We could play a game.
473:
Come off it! Find another sucker
to play cards with. You've got nine aces in your deck.
474: It doesn't have to be cards.
475:
Here's a good game: cities.
I say "Moscow."
476:
You name a city starting with W,
like Warsaw. Then you say one with W. Understand?
477:
Now you, Fedya.
Name one beginning with W.
478:
Vorkuta.
Why? I did time there.
479:
- All right. Your turn: a city beginning with A.
- Dzhambul. - What has Dzhambul got to do with it?
480:
It's warm there.
My home is there. My mother is there.
481:
Let's play something else. I'll step out,
you hide something, and I'll find it.
482:
- You'd do better to find the helmet.
- Be quiet.
483:
- We hide it and he peeks through a crack?
- Then you go out and hide something.
484:
And you make sure I don't peek.
- Why me? It's always Fedya!
485:
- I'll tear your mouth off, you rascal!
- Mouth, mouth...
486:
- Docent, were you ever little?
- Yes.
487:
- Did you have a mother and father?
- Yes.
488:
Why are you so mean?
Why are you like a dog?
490:
- He came on his own.
- Ah, you're here too.
491:
I tried your place,
but I could tell it was staked out.
492: Mityai, I need somewhere to hide.
494:
- Where are we going?
- Keep walking.
495:
- Sorry we troubled you for nothing, doctor.
- It's all right.
496:
Give him valerian, warm tea,
and let him sleep. - Thank you.
497:
- Does it hurt, Garik?
- It hurts, Vasya. Read it.
499:
"Dear Dad, hello. We found out
you're in prison,
500:
and we were very happy,
because we thought you were dead."
501:
What rat told that little Squinty
about his father?
502:
"Mom was happy too. When your letter
arrived, she cried all day,
503:
but before that, she told me
you were a test pilot."
504: A test pilot... testing people's pockets.
505:
"I'm still glad you're alive,
because Mom says
506:
you're a good man,
but weak-willed."
507:
That's right! Too weak-willed to resist
stealing our money and blaming the cabdriver.
508:
Get out of here!
I'll break your horns off, radish!
510:
Aren't you ashamed? You're forty years old.
Half your lives are behind you.
511:
What's in your past?
Your present? Your future?
512:
Darkness, filth, nothing human!
Come to your senses before it's too late. That's my advice.
513:
Docent, we'd better clear out.
That doctor will report us to the police.
514:
- She won't. - Why?
- I took a razor to her throat...
515:
She's in the well.
Go look if you like.
516: How much time did I have? One year.
518:
How much for the kindergarten
and the apartment? Say ten!
520:
And for a lousy fourteen years,
I must put up with this snake?
521:
Who put that old woman in the well?
Do what you like. I'm going to the police.
522: Go on! He won't hurt you.
523:
And you? You'll put up with him
until you die?
524:
Vasya, I told him earlier,
"I have a cold," and he...
525:
Enough about your cold!
Come here...
527:
- What are you doing?
- Cleaning the carpet.
528:
Well, comrades, the comedy is over.
First, I'm taking this off.
530:
I'll serve my time, then that's it.
I'm going straight! I'll get a job.
531:
- Doing what? A guard at the collective farm back home?
- Why a guard?
532:
I could clear snow, lay bricks,
or translate. I know English.
533:
If only we'd brought the hat, too!
Who is Docent? A crook.
534:
- Plenty of crooks, only one hat.
- They'd reduce our sentences for the helmet.
535:
Where did he put it?
We went everywhere.
536:
Crook! I told you I had a cold,
and all you said was, "I'll tear your mouth off."
537:
- You made me dive in that freezing weather!
- When did he make you dive?
538:
When they caught us. Remember?
He said, "I'm fishing, and you dive in."
539:
- Wait. What did he say about fish?
- "I'm fishing in an ice hole,
540:
and you, Cross-Eye, can you swim?"
- He hid the helmet in the ice hole!
541:
That's right! I remember, the radish!
It's in the ice hole at Malakhovka!
542:
Why didn't you say so, you lout?
You could've left a note before hanging yourself. - Let's go.
543:
- What about him?
- Let them collect him. I'm not carrying that great ox. Come on!
545:
- There's nothing there.
- It's there, on the bottom. You have to dive.
546:
Why me? It's always Cross-Eye!
Vasya, tell him to get in himself.
547: I can't! It's cold. I'll get sick.
548:
- He was hanging himself a minute ago, and now he's afraid of a cold!
- Greetings, sports fans!
550:
- Where's the boat station?
- Over there.
551:
I'd kill you,
but I haven't got the time!
552:
Now there are two of them.
And another one at the country house.
554:
- One!
- Well done, Fyodor Petrovich! Well done!
555:
- Two.
- The more we turn in, the better.
